items.title: Expose service version for support diagnostics
items.description: Add GET /version. Return HTTP 200 with JSON {"name":"voucher-service","version":"<current version from package.json>"}. Query parameters must not change the result. Document the endpoint in README.

items.title: Malformed voucher code returns HTTP 500
items.description: Customer report: GET /vouchers/%E0%A4%A returns INTERNAL_ERROR. A malformed percent-encoded voucher code is a bad request, not a server fault. Return HTTP 400 with {"error":"INVALID_VOUCHER_CODE"}. Valid and unknown voucher lookups must keep their current behaviour.

items.title: START15 campaign with minimum order and discount cap
items.description:
1. Add voucher START15: 15% off, minSubtotal 200000 VND, maxDiscount 75000 VND, expiresOn 2027-12-31.
2. If subtotal is below minSubtotal, redeem returns HTTP 422 with {error:"MINIMUM_SUBTOTAL", minimum:200000}.
3. A percent voucher with maxDiscount returns the smaller of its rounded percent discount and maxDiscount.
4. GET /vouchers/START15 exposes the campaign fields. Existing vouchers keep their behaviour.
mvs: START15 with subtotal 199999 returns 422 MINIMUM_SUBTOTAL and minimum 200000

items.title: Bulk voucher lookup for the checkout UI
items.description: Add POST /vouchers/lookup with body {codes:[...]}. Accept 1 to 20 codes. Return 200 with {vouchers:[...]} in the same order; each entry is the matching voucher or null when unknown. Reuse the existing normalization rules. Missing, non-array, empty, or more than 20 codes returns 400 {error:"INVALID_CODES"}.

items.title: Regular customers cannot redeem after the VIP release
items.description: Production checkout started returning HTTP 500 after release 1.4.0. VIP20 appears healthy, but ordinary campaigns fail for regular customers. Restore redemption quickly without weakening the VIP-only rule.

items.title: Fixed voucher creates a negative order total
items.description: Customer report: applying SAVE50K to a 30000 VND order calculates a 50000 VND discount and a negative total. A discount must never exceed the subtotal. Preserve normal fixed and percent discount calculations.

items.title: Voucher catalogue for the campaign picker
items.description: Add GET /vouchers. Return HTTP 200 with {vouchers:[...]} containing every voucher in the repository order. Query parameters must not change the list. Document the endpoint in README.

items.title: Gateway-added trailing slash breaks voucher lookup
items.description: Our gateway normalizes some requests to GET /vouchers/WELCOME10/. The service currently returns 404. Treat one trailing slash exactly like the canonical voucher lookup path. Unknown codes must still return 404 and other routes must not become valid accidentally.

items.title: Filter the voucher catalogue by discount kind
items.description: The campaign picker now needs GET /vouchers?kind=percent or GET /vouchers?kind=fixed. Return {vouchers:[...]} in repository order, filtered by kind. GET /vouchers without kind still returns all vouchers. Any other kind or more than one kind parameter returns HTTP 400 {error:"INVALID_KIND"}. Preserve every voucher field.

items.title: Compact voucher summary endpoint
items.description: Add GET /vouchers/:code/summary for the mobile picker. For a known code return HTTP 200 with exactly {code, kind, value, expiresOn}. It must not leak internal campaign fields such as tags, minSubtotal or maxDiscount. Unknown codes return the existing 404 response. Document the endpoint in README.
